title: Photo of Ed Nather
summary: Photo of Ed Nather, the astronomer who wrote The Story of Mel
description: Photograph of Ed Nather, the University of Texas astronomer who posted The Story of Mel to Usenet in 1983. Uploaded to Wikimedia Commons in 2014 by the user Natherw as their own work and released into the public domain; the date the photograph was taken is not recorded.
